attributes.action: Hold Government to account on Timms Review promises
attributes.background: The Timms Review, despite promises made to parliament, has not been co-produced with Disabled people and our organisations. We call for a halt & reversal of cuts, and an independent review led democratically by Disabled people and our organisations, including our trade unions.

rejection.details:
We find this unclear - we don't know exactly what promises and commitments are being referred to here - who made them, where and when, and what they were.

Nor do we know exactly which cuts affecting disabled people you are referring to.
